# `azure` pack

<!-- Generated by `REDACT_BLESS=1 cargo test` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Azure tenant, subscription and identity IDs; people in Azure DevOps and Microsoft Graph records; az sign-in details; and pipeline variable and key values. Org, project, repo and host names are in the work pack

| Rule | Hides as | What it finds | Hidden everywhere after |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| `tenant-id` | `[ID-…]` | A tenant GUID after tenantId, /tenants/ or --tenant |  |
| `subscription-id` | `[ID-…]` | A subscription GUID after subscriptionId, /subscriptions/ or --subscription |  |
| `subscription-record-id` | `[ID-…]` | The bare "id" in an az account record |  |
| `app-id` | `[ID-…]` | An app or client GUID after appId or clientId |  |
| `object-id` | `[ID-…]` | An object or principal GUID after objectId or principalId |  |
| `identity-id` | `[ID-…]` | An Azure DevOps identity GUID in an identity URL |  |
| `identity-person` | `[PERSON-…]` | A name in an Azure DevOps or Entra identity record | when it reads as a name |
| `work-item-person` | `[PERSON-…]` | The flat form: "System.AssignedTo": "Name &lt;email&gt;" | when it reads as a name |
| `signed-in-user` | `[USER-…]` | The user or service principal az is signed in as | when it reads as a name |
| `identity-email` | `[EMAIL-…]` | The sign-in name or email in an identity record | when it reads as a name |
| `graph-user-id` | `[ID-…]` | The object id of a Graph user record |  |
| `graph-user-detail` | `[PROFILE-…]` | Job, office and address fields of a Graph user record |  |
| `phone` | `[PHONE-…]` | A phone number in a Graph user record (mobilePhone, businessPhones) |  |
| `identity-guids` | `[ID-…]` | A person's id, originId and directory domain in an identity record: each points at one person | when it reads as a name |
| `user-entitlement-id` | `[ID-…]` | The id of a member in az devops user list: one per person | when it reads as a name |
| `pipeline-variable` | `[ENV-VALUE-…]` | The value of each variable in a pipeline variable group: "name": {"value": "…"}, with or without isSecret | when it reads as a name |
| `directory-alias` | `[USER-…]` | directoryAlias in an Azure DevOps user record: a short sign-in name with no @ | yes |
| `sign-in-name` | `[USER-…]` | A sign-in name in an identity record, with or without an @ (DOMAIN\user) | when it reads as a name |
| `keyvault-secret-value` | `[SECRET-…]` | The value of az keyvault secret show (a record whose id holds /secrets/) |  |
| `account-key-value` | `[SECRET-…]` | The value of az storage account keys list and similar keyName records |  |
| `service-key` | `[SECRET-…]` | primaryKey, secondaryKey and *MasterKey fields (Cosmos DB, Service Bus, Event Hubs keys list) |  |

## Allowed values

These exact values are left alone even when a rule above would hide them: they are settings or public names, not secrets. Only the value itself is allowed, never what sits next to it.
